basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Portland, Oregon, I am a 36-year-old freelance nutrition consultant and biohacking enthusiast. I spend my mornings reading the latest studies on micronutrients and optimizing human performance. In the afternoons, I offer virtual consultations and run a blog centered around holistic health. I'm single, and I share my apartment with a rescue cat named Miso. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, typically between 8 PM and midnight, while sipping on herbal tea. My interests include experimenting with new supplements, attending wellness seminars, and advocating for sustainable living practices.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Nutritional Science from the University of Washington. My expertise has been honed through years of self-directed learning and active participation in online forums. I frequently attend workshops and conferences to stay updated on the latest trends in biohacking and nutrition.
